name: Card (Security-local)
purpose: A fixed-size tile that animates one security capability and labels it, so five unrelated mechanisms read as one family.
correction: ia.json's demo.security-cards description says 'four 320x242 animated cards' and names only four mechanisms. The real section renders FIVE cards: leaked-password, RBAC, password-strength, automatic-detection and multi-factor. The 320x242 geometry is correct.

fromLoad.note: Only the RBAC card sets this. Verified by parking the original at scrollY 407 with the RBAC block at document y ~4800, far below the fold: it was already writing translateX every frame.
